subject: crm.records

entries.definition: An organization record representing a company, group, or other organizational party, with its own classification, status, references, contacts, and related work.
A person record with grounded identity and relationship facts that may refer to one or more organizations without inheriting provider-specific identity or authority.

limitations: This vocabulary owns portable CRM organization, person, and relationship terms only.
Communication, Project, Task, and Meeting terms are governed by independently selectable Context packs.
A provider participant is not a CRM person unless a separate governed identity-resolution contract establishes the relationship.
